notes: • Code blocks in replies have a copy button in their corner that copies the code without its fences, on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android. On the Mac, text in the chat can now be selected with the pointer: paragraphs, headings, list items, table cells and code blocks of replies, your own messages, the agent's questions and tool output. Copy it with ⌘C or a right-click; the right-click menu on a message offers Copy (the selection), Copy Message and Select Text.
